en.name: Mole paste
en.summary: Mole paste is chillies, nuts, seeds and often chocolate ground into a stiff concentrate that you thin with stock. Unopened it keeps about 12 months in a cool dark cupboard. Once opened, refrigerate it for about 1–3 months, or freeze it for about 6 months.
en.pantry: Unopened jars and tubs keep in a cool dark cupboard for about 12 months from purchase — a figure trimmed down from the hoisin sauce line, because mole carries far more nut and seed oil than hoisin does and goes rancid sooner. That oil is the real clock: a rancid, crayon-like smell is the end of a jar even when it looks perfect. Keep it away from the hob and out of sunlight, both of which accelerate the fat.
en.fridge: Once opened, refrigerate at 4 °C (40 °F) or below and use within about 1–3 months. Press the surface flat and either film it with a thin layer of oil or press cling film directly onto it, so no air sits on the paste — an exposed surface dries into a dark crust and goes rancid first. Always use a clean dry spoon. Mould on the surface of an opened jar means the whole jar goes, not just the top.
en.freezer: Mole paste freezes very well because it is low in water, and about 6 months at −18 °C (0 °F) is a fair limit. Freeze it in tablespoon-sized blobs on a lined tray, then bag them, so you thaw only what one pot needs. Frozen food held at that temperature stays safe indefinitely; what drifts is the aroma of the toasted chillies and spices. This is the best way to handle a large tub you cannot work through quickly.
en.thawing: Thaw a frozen blob in the fridge, or drop it straight into a hot pan with stock and whisk it out. Do not thaw it at room temperature.
spoilage: A rancid, crayon-like or paint-like smell from the nut and seed oils
Mould on the surface or around the rim of an opened jar
A fermented or yeasty smell, or a domed lid
The paste dried into a hard dark crust with oil separated on top
tips: Film the surface with oil or press cling film onto it after every use.
Freeze in tablespoon blobs — one pot of mole rarely needs a whole tub.
Store away from heat and light; the nut oils are what fail first.
Made-up mole sauce, thinned with stock, is a cooked dish: it keeps 3 to 4 days refrigerated or 2 to 3 months frozen.

faq.q: How long does mole paste last once opened?
faq.a: About 1–3 months refrigerated at 4 °C or below, with the surface covered so no air sits on it.
Yes, very well — about 6 months at −18 °C. Freeze it in tablespoon blobs and bag them.

faq.q: How long does an unopened jar of mole paste keep?
faq.a: About 12 months in a cool dark cupboard. The nut and seed oils, not bacteria, are what set the limit.

faq.q: How long does made-up mole sauce keep?
faq.a: As a cooked dish: 3 to 4 days refrigerated, or 2 to 3 months frozen.

zh.name: 摩爾醬（濃縮醬磚）
zh.summary: 摩爾醬是把乾辣椒、堅果、種子，常常還有巧克力一起磨成的濃稠醬膏，使用時再用高湯調開。未開封放陰涼避光的櫥櫃大約 12 個月。開封後冷藏大約 1～3 個月，或冷凍大約 6 個月。
zh.pantry: 未開封的玻璃罐和盒裝放在陰涼避光的櫥櫃，從購買日起算大約 12 個月——這個數字是從海鮮醬的資料往下修過的，因為摩爾醬的堅果與種子油脂遠多於海鮮醬，走油耗也更快。那些油脂才是真正的時鐘：只要聞到油耗味或蠟筆味，即使外觀完好，這一罐也已經結束了。請遠離爐火、避免日曬，這兩者都會加速油脂劣化。
zh.fridge: 開封後請放 4 °C 以下冷藏，並在大約 1～3 個月內用完。把表面抹平，再淋一層薄油或直接把保鮮膜壓在醬面上，讓空氣碰不到醬——裸露的表面會先乾成深色硬殼，也最先走油耗。每次都用乾淨乾燥的湯匙。開封罐的醬面長霉就整罐丟掉，不是只挖掉上層。
zh.freezer: 摩爾醬水分少，非常適合冷凍，在 −18 °C 大約 6 個月是合理上限。用大匙挖成一球球放在鋪紙的盤子上凍硬，再裝袋，這樣一次只解凍一鍋要用的量。食物在這個溫度下安全性可以無限期維持，會流失的是烘過的辣椒與香料的香氣。一大盒短期內用不完，這就是最好的處理方式。
zh.thawing: 冷凍的醬球請放冷藏解凍，或直接丟進加了高湯的熱鍋攪開。不要放在室溫解凍。
spoilage: 堅果與種子油發出油耗味、蠟筆味或油漆味
開封罐的醬面或瓶口周圍長霉
有發酵味或酵母味，或蓋子鼓起
醬乾成深色硬殼，上面分離出一層油
tips: 每次用完都在表面淋薄油或壓上保鮮膜。
用大匙分成小球冷凍——煮一鍋很少需要用掉一整盒。
遠離熱源和光線；最先失守的是堅果油脂。
用高湯調開、煮熟的摩爾醬是一道熟食：冷藏可放 3 到 4 天，冷凍 2 到 3 個月。

faq.q: 摩爾醬開封後可以放多久？
faq.a: 放 4 °C 以下冷藏大約 1～3 個月，並把表面蓋住不讓空氣接觸。
可以，而且效果很好——在 −18 °C 大約 6 個月。挖成一球球凍硬後裝袋。

faq.q: 未開封的摩爾醬可以放多久？
faq.a: 陰涼避光的櫥櫃大約 12 個月。決定期限的是堅果與種子油脂，不是細菌。

faq.q: 調好煮熟的摩爾醬可以放多久？
faq.a: 當成熟食看待：冷藏 3 到 4 天，或冷凍 2 到 3 個月。
